title: Mississippi Sound this week: October 30, 2026
headline: The Pearl, Pascagoula, Wolf and Biloxi rivers are running low, so the Sound is saltier than usual for late October. All 21 monitored beaches are clear for swimming.
lines: The Pearl River near Bogalusa is at its third-lowest late-October flow since 1998. Only 2000 and 2010 were lower.
The Pascagoula River at Merrill is at its third-lowest late-October flow since 1998. Only 2000 and 2010 were lower.
The Wolf River near Landon is at its third-lowest late-October flow since 1998. Only 2000 and 2023 were lower.
Rivers over the last 60 days look most like 2016, 2023 and 2010 (background, not a forecast).
